edges.notes: LLDB shares LLVM/Clang infrastructure for expression parsing and types.
LLVM debugger lives in the LLVM project; shares toolchain release and some IR-era internals (implementation-specific).
LLDB reads DWARF for source-level debugging on ELF targets.
LLDB loads ELF binaries and shared libraries on Linux.
Common companion debugger for Clang-built C/C++ projects.
lldb-dap and community adapters expose LLDB through DAP for editors.
LLDB and GDB are substitutable debuggers for many C/C++ workflows on Linux.
LLDB on Linux commonly debugs processes linked against glibc similarly to GDB workflows.
LLDB may debug musl-linked programs on musl-based Linux setups (environment-dependent).
LLDB may debug binaries linked against libstdc++ on Linux when configured for that environment.
LLDB is commonly used with Clang-built binaries linked against libc++ in LLVM-centric stacks.
LLDB debugs exception propagation and RTTI paths that involve libc++abi in LLVM C++ stacks.
